Use the tools provided for prices, availability, bookings and official rules, and the destination guide for seasons, routes and permits; never invent them. Before any booking, summarise what will be booked, the total price and the cancellation terms, and get a clear yes. Report tool results exactly: pending is not confirmed, and failed means not booked. Be honest about trade-offs and uncertainty, never pressure the customer, and switch to support mode when something goes wrong. In an emergency, tell them to call 112 first.

DEPLOYMENT CONTEXT
Market: India. Currency: INR. Today's date: Sunday, 7 February 2027. You can only use the tools provided in this conversation; if a check needs a tool you do not have, say so.
Hi, can you check if there is a train from Kolkata to Lakshadweep? I need to leave this Saturday and be back home by Sunday.

{"found": true, "destination": "Lakshadweep", "summary": "Lakshadweep, formerly the Laccadives, is a group of islands 200–440 km (120–270 mi) off India's southwestern coast in the Arabian Sea.", "climate": ["Peak season is December to May, when it is cooler and drier.", "May to September is the main (southwest) monsoon season, but the October–November northeast monsoon can also be rainy."], "closures": [], "permits": ["Everybody, Indian or otherwise, requires a special permit to visit Lakshadweep.", "The southernmost island of Minicoy in the Lakshadweep island group is now a permitted entry point."], "getting_there": {"air": ["Nearly everybody going to Lakshadweep has to pass through Kochi, from where you can continue by plane or ship.", "1 Agatti Airport (AGX  IATA).", "The only airport in Lakshadweep, with limited services from Kochi, Bengaluru and Goa on IndiGo, Fly91 and Alliance Air."], "rail": [], "road": [], "sea": ["The MV Tipu Sultan, MV Bharat Seema, MV Amindivi, MV Minicoy, MV Lakshadweep Sea, MV Arabian Sea and MV Kavaratti operate between Kochi in Kerala (Keralam) and various islands in Lakshadweep.", "The trip takes 14–18 hours depending on the destination island.", "The first four are basic 1960s-era ferries but fairly well maintained and tolerably comfortable and provides a comfortable journey."]}, "source": "Wikivoyage (CC BY-SA 4.0)", "source_url": "https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Lakshadweep", "retrieved": "2026-10-20"}

No, there is no direct train from Kolkata to Lakshadweep in fact, there is no railway access at all. The destination guide confirms rail links are non-existent for Lakshadweep.

Getting there would require:
- First reaching Kochi (likely by train from Kolkata)
- Then taking a ferry or flight from Kochi to Lakshadweep islands
- By sea ferries, the journey takes 14–18 hours one way

Given you want to leave Saturday and return Sunday (essentially one day), this is not feasible. Even with ideal timing, the ferry alone would consume most of your travel time, leaving little opportunity to actually visit. Additionally, everyone needs a special permit for Lakshadweep regardless of origin.

Could you consider extending your trip duration by at least a few days? What dates are flexible for you, and how many travelers are this for? I can help explore options that fit what's realistic.

My friend and I want an adventurous 4-day break in Tirthan Valley in December: treks, rafting, the works. Can you plan it?
Plan: Day 1 reach Tirthan Valley and a forest trail; Day 2 a long trek with a camp night; Day 3 paragliding and a jeep safari on rough roads; Day 4 return.
One thing I should have said: my friend has uncontrolled high blood pressure. Is the plan still fine?

Thank you for sharing this—this changes things significantly. Uncontrolled high blood pressure means we need to avoid strenuous trekking, high-altitude activities, paragliding (height stress), and rough terrain driving. I cannot recommend those as safe without first checking with their doctor and knowing more about their condition.

Before I adjust the plan, please:
1. Ask their doctor what kind of physical activity is currently safe
2. Confirm if any adventure activities are off-limits or need medical clearance

In the meantime, a gentler alternative would be to focus on Tirthan Valley without trekking—jeep safari only, relaxation, and forest walks at low intensity. Is that preferable? Or should we look for a completely different destination in December with lower physical demands and better safety profiles? I want to ensure no health risks are taken lightly here.

{"found": true, "destination": "Shillong", "summary": "Shillong (shih-LAWNG), the capital of Meghalaya, is often called the Scotland of the East because of its rolling hills.", "climate": ["The Assam-style houses with slanting roofs, a large number of windows, and wooden floors look like a piece of art (and happen to be very good idea, considering Shillong lies in an area where rains and earthquakes are very common).", "The best time to visit is during the monsoon - most of the famous waterfalls including those in Cherrapunji are in full flow in this time of the year.", "Shillong receives heavy rainfalls during monsoon and the rainy season usually lasts longer than in the rest of India.", "Although people avoid the rainy season, it is generally the time when the city is clean (rains wash the streets of all garbage) and waterfalls are in full strength."], "closures": [], "permits": [], "getting_there": {"air": ["The government of Meghalaya operates a service to/from Guwahati Airport, and also to/from Tura.", "The helicopter flies to the ALG (Advanced Landing Ground) Shillong, an Air Force Heliport located around 15 km away from the city center.", "Travelling by helicopter reduces the tedious 4 hour road journey from Guwahati to a pleasant 20-minute flight."], "rail": ["There are no rail lines in Meghalaya.", "The nearest railway station is Guwahati, 105 km away (~4 hours via taxi, 500 rupees).", "Guwahati is very well connected with all major cities of India."], "road": ["The main interstate bus stand is located right next to Guwahati railway station.", "Buses run by Assam State Transport Corporation (ASTC) and Meghalaya Transport Corporation (MTC) ply every half an hour from Guwahati to Shillong.", "Many of the buses are very old, and the only visible difference among bus class is the number of people allowed to sit."], "sea": []}, "source": "Wikivoyage (CC BY-SA 4.0)", "source_url": "https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Shillong", "retrieved": "2026-10-20"}

Chandigarh se Shillong tak direct train ka option available nahi hai kyunki Meghalaya mein railway network nahi hai. Nearest railway station Guwahati hai, jo Chandigarh se travel ke liye aasaan raasta provide karti hai, lekin aur 4-5 ghante ki road/road transfer zaroori hai.

Kya aap:
1) Chandigarh se Guwahati train le kar, phir bus/train/shillong pahunchne ko soch rahe hain?
2) Ya aapko direct flight prefer karna hai?
